recommended_path: Regenerate the effective round package and dispatch from the latest base package after freezing the complete working-tree test and runner surface, then run a fresh no-context test-quality audit.

findings.title: The dispatch-bound round package is stale and omits changed test-runner surfaces
findings.rationale: The round package omitted the live probe, package manifest and race wrapper and reported 304 tests while the current suite has 306 passing tests.
findings.suggested_action: Regenerate the effective package and dispatch from the refreshed bounded package, then rerun with a fresh reviewer.
